<kbabbitt> ... if we know min() and 2 args are same unit, we'll throw away the larger value, it can't ever be the result of min
<kbabbitt> ... question is, when dealing with percentages, you don't necessarily know what the sign of a percentage will resolve to
<kbabbitt> ... depends on what it resolves against
<kbabbitt> ... positive percentage in background-position might be a negative number, for example
<kbabbitt> ... cannot naively look at two %s and tell which one is larger or smaller in general
